name: DeadZone Lite
description: Base modified ROM style — all automatic ROM mods run here. Stable/Legend/Ninja inherit Lite.

mods.name: Signature Verification Bypass
mods.description: Bypasses APK signature verification on A14/A15/A16 via smali patches to ApkSigningBlockUtils, StrictJarVerifier, SigningDetails, and related classes

mods.name: invoke-custom handling
mods.description: Handles invoke-custom smali instructions in framework — replaces equals/hashCode/toString bodies that contain invoke-custom with safe stubs

mods.name: fix bootloop A15
mods.description: Fixes A15 bootloop caused by specific smali files across framework_unpacked, services_unpacked, and miui_services_unpacked

mods.name: Kousei / Kaorios Toolbox
mods.description: Kaorios Toolbox V2.0.4 integration: APK install, privapp XML, build.prop, classes.dex injection, and V2.0.3+ smali hooks

mods.name: OS1 Mods
mods.description: OS1 (HyperOS 1 / MIUI) specific ROM mods — conditional on rom_os=OS1

mods.name: OS2 Mods
mods.description: OS2 (HyperOS 2) specific ROM mods — conditional on rom_os=OS2

mods.name: OS3 Mods
mods.description: OS3 (HyperOS 3) specific ROM mods — conditional on rom_os=OS3

mods.name: Universal Mods
mods.description: Universal ROM mods applied to all devices and all OS versions

mods.name: UpdateFile Mods
mods.description: UpdateFile ROM mods (device patches, region fixes, theme, fonts). DeadZone_FrameworkPatcher and DeadZone_KaoriosToolbox in UpdateFile remain gated by their env flags to prevent duplicate execution.
